out.detail: lower body injury, likely to miss second straight game

away.summary: The Lightning (8-3-1) are coming off a 6-4 win over Winnipeg and project to dress 11 forwards and seven defensemen again. Andrei Vasilevskiy is listed first among projected goaltenders ahead of Dennis Hildeby. Girgensons and Gourde are injured, while Crozier and Sabourin are scratched.

home.summary: The Predators (4-4-5) lost 4-3 to Washington on Thursday and are projected to dress 11 forwards and seven defensemen. Juuse Saros is listed first among projected goaltenders ahead of Justus Annunen. Nicolas Hague was benched in the third period Thursday after a misplay and penalty, but he remains in the projected lineup.
